props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables interaction. Mirrors the ARIA name.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name. An icon-only control with no name is announced as just "button", which tells a screen-reader user nothing.

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a busy state and blocks interaction.

props.name: form
props.description: The `id` of a `<form>` element to associate this element with.

props.name: name
props.description: The name of the element, used when submitting an HTML form.

ai.summary: A square, icon-only control for actions that need no label, such as edit or delete.
whenToUse: The action is unambiguous from a well-known icon
Space is tight, such as a toolbar or a table row
The control sits next to a labelled control that implies the group
whenNotToUse: The action is not obvious from the icon alone — use a Button with a label
It is the primary or most common action on the page — use a Button
It performs navigation — use a Link instead
ai.accessibility: Button role with an explicit accessible name from the required `label` prop. The slotted icon is aria-hidden because it carries no information the name does not. A missing label warns in development.
knownLimitations: The `label` prop is required in the React types but only warns in plain HTML
